name: Ganakton the Tempest

abilities.name: Shed Lightning
abilities.description: The boss deals moderate shock damage over time to all players. This attack cannot be avoided.

abilities.name: Shocking Breath
abilities.description: The boss breaths lightning from its mouth dealing moderate shock damage over time in front of itself as indicated by a red cone.

abilities.name: Trapping Bolt
abilities.description: The boss pins a player down dealing moderate shock damage, this can be broken free from.

abilities.name: Lightning Spit
abilities.description: The boss releases a fast moving lightning whirl toward a player dealing high shock damage and stunning them afterwards. It may be difficult to avoid this if you are standing too near the boss.

notes: Its unique drop, Belisaro's Bolt, is named after Belisaro, the Imperial that named the wamasu. "Ganakton" was a moniker for an aunt that he hated, who was rumored to possess Orcish blood. Ganakton terrorized the Imperials while they were constructing Arx Corinium, having razed the eastern wall a dozen times.
related_quests: Force of Nature: Help three nereid sisters reclaim an abandoned Imperial fort.
Pledge: Arx Corinium: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Arx Corinium.
summary: Ganakton the Tempest is a large Wamasu and the first boss in Arx Corinium. Its unique drop is Belisaro's Bolt, a unique item in the Lamia's Song item set.
